summary: Phase A Admin Curriculum CRUD (modules + sessions) end-to-end tested. All 19 backend pytest cases PASSED (auth 401/403 guardrails, list/reads shape, create/patch/delete lifecycle, cascade-delete of sessions, impact preview, validation errors). Frontend UI smoke also PASSED: curriculum-tab renders under /admin-panel?tab=curriculum for admin, add-module/session buttons visible, module click reveals sessions-list, delete confirmation modal opens with cascade counts (0 sessions/0 notes/0 quiz/0 IQ for empty test modules), delete-confirm-btn removes the module, and non-admin (testagent2026) is redirected away from /admin-panel (curriculum-tab not visible).

minor.issue: N+1 query pattern — the endpoint loops over every module and issues a separate _supabase_get(session_count) call per module. With 23 modules the full response takes ~30-90s under load. Consider a single grouped count RPC or PostgREST embed (master_modules?select=id,title,module_number,order_index,master_sessions(count)) to cut round-trips.

issues: ESLint warning: useEffect on CurriculumTab.jsx line 60 declares missing dependency 'reloadModules'. Non-blocking but flagged in `yarn build` output.

action_items: (Optional) Optimize GET /api/admin/curriculum/modules to avoid N+1 session-count queries. Currently the list can take ~30-90s.
(Optional) Silence eslint 'exhaustive-deps' warning on CurriculumTab.jsx:60 (already prefixed with an eslint-disable-next-line but appears one line too early — comment on line 60 targets line 61).
critical_code_review_comments: wave_endpoints.py admin_curr_modules() (line 1067) iterates per-module _supabase_get for session counts — replace with a single grouped query. Not blocking but painful UX for the admin.

wave_endpoints.py admin_create_module() (line 1096): fallback module_number derivation uses `(existing[0].get('module_number') or existing[0]['order_index']) + 1`; when the very last existing module has NULL module_number and low order_index this could collide with lower numbers. Works today because seed data has module_number populated, but worth adding a MAX() check.
CurriculumTab.jsx uses `window.prompt` and `alert` for add/rename/error UX. Fine for admin-only Phase A but should move to a proper modal in Phase B alongside the notes/quiz/IQ editors.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up __TEST_TB, __TEST_RENAMED, __TEST_second_sess (backend tests) and __TEST_UI_MOD, __TEST_UI_MOD_XYZ (UI tests). All confirmed deleted via backend cleanup script.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase A (modules + sessions CRUD) is stable. Backend endpoints /api/admin/curriculum/modules, /api/admin/curriculum/sessions, /api/admin/modules[/{id}], /api/admin/modules/{id}/impact, /api/admin/sessions[/{id}] all return 401 unauth / 403 non-admin / 200 admin. Cascade delete works (module delete removes child sessions). UI tab under /admin-panel?tab=curriculum functions end-to-end. For Phase B (notes/quiz/IQ editors) — those are gated in the right-rail placeholder and explicitly out of scope for this iteration.
